name: cloud.viitor.virtual-mirror
description:
Real-time virtual mirror for Unity. An OAK-D depth camera drives a VRM avatar that mirrors a person standing in front of a display. Whole-body 3D pose runs in an out-of-process Python sidecar and streams over UDP, so an inference crash cannot take the player down with it.

Windows-only. Requires an OAK-D camera, Python 3.10 and a ~369 MB RTMW3D ONNX model that is not bundled - see the README for setup.

Pre-1.0: several acceptance tests have not been run against a live camera and there is a known arm/hip clipping defect. Read 'Known limitations' in the README before shipping this to end users.
